native.decoder_limit: TShark 4.6.9 later dynamic-QPACK authority/path values were inconsistent. The independent request field oracle is limited to the first valid fields on streams 0 and 4. Later google.com reuse is supported by NetLog and CDP, not those decoded fields.

surf_linux.analyzer: TShark 4.6.9 with private diagnostic key log

scope.firefox_early_get: Native Firefox early GET acceptance remains unconfirmed; this audit does not close ECH-03.
scope.public_initial_protocol: Surf and Chromium public cold-start eligibility/history differ; no full first-protocol parity claim. Docker public sample selected H2 only.
scope.privacy: One Surf client context and optional application keys; no synthetic browser document NAK.
scope.candidate_order: Generic engine key order is not Chromium port/host ordering for multiple eligible peers.
scope.tls_scope: Confirmed verified chains/hostname. Custom verification or configured client credentials keep dedicated connections.
scope.native_timing: Native UDP bytes only, no native NIC pacing claim.
